description: Returns one publisher's figures for one report in the MORVS Government Data Demand Register. Figures are that publisher's own counts for its own period and scope. Companies count differently. Never add or rank figures across companies. A missing figure means not reported, not zero. National-security figures remain bands. These aggregate counts cannot show whether any person's data was requested. Defaults to the latest complete report; optional filters select exact fact fields.

geo.description: Exact ISO alpha-2 country code or WORLD, NONUS or XX; omit for every geography.

limit.description: Maximum facts returned after filters; default 50, allowed 1-200. Aggregate counts cannot show whether any person's data was requested.

measure.description: Exact measure id; omit for every measure. Counts with different units must not be added or ranked across publishers.

period.description: Exact report period: YYYY-H1, YYYY-H2, YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD_YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to the latest complete report.

process.description: Exact legal-process id; omit for every process. National-security figures remain bands.

series.description: Exact published series id; omit for every series. A missing figure means not reported, not zero.

source.description: Publisher id in the register, e.g. google or verizon. Unknown ids return the valid list. Figures are each publisher's own counts for its own period and scope.

name: data_demand_source
title: Get Publisher Data Demand Report
